sections.title: Coverage
sections.content: All frozen manifest sources have complete paged coverage. Summaries are bounded, redacted, and preserve source status and principal obligations.

sections.title: Semantics
sections.content: The sources consistently define non-authorizing, hash-bound, fail-closed execution, acceptance, lifecycle, authority, recovery, routing, segmentation, and verification controls.

sections.title: Decision Basis
sections.content: Coverage is sufficient for bounded semantic context. No execution or lifecycle authorization is granted.
